AT YOUR OWN PACE

An idea for every stage.

Age guides help you begin. Each activity includes ways to make it simpler or take it further.

3–5yearsLittle explorersSimple choices, big discoveries.↗6–8yearsCurious makersA little more independence.↗9–12yearsBig thinkersRoom to test your own ideas.↗

Age guides, not age rules.

These three doors sort the same ten activities by the kind of help they need, not by what children “should” do. A confident three-year-old and a cautious six-year-old may both love the sound map; a nine-year-old who has never mixed paint will get as much from the colour mixing as a five-year-old who has. Read each age page as a starting point, watch your child, and step in or step back as the moment asks — every activity page lists the same adaptations so you can move between ages without changing activities.
